chunks: And in the narration of Jamil ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
"The basket that was brought to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم contained twenty sa's of dates."

key_terms.صَاعًا: a sa', a recognized measure of volume

ai.seo_question: How much did the basket brought to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم contain according to the narration of Jamil ibn Darraj?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the basket brought to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم contained twenty sa's of dates. In its legal context, it serves as a transmitted report relevant to rulings connected to expiation in Ramadan.
